text:
noah: Quick thought — proposing an 'observer bridge' as a thin stateful proxy to coordinate canary switchover and automatic fallback. It holds the canary lease, synthesizes runtime health, and emits tie-break decisions. sketch below.

maya: +1, want clarity on interface boundaries. Is observer in front of the router or colocated with it?

noah: Colocated with the router as a sidecar-ish control plane. It subscribes to runtime telemetry, maintains a small lease DB, and exposes a REST gRPC decision API. Pros: single decision plane, audit trail, flexible rollout rules. Cons: extra hop and state sync.

alex: Main worry is added p90 latency. Have we budgeted the extra RTT?

noah: In our perf sim the extra hop is ~1–2ms when colocated; worst-case 8–10ms cross-az. We mitigate with local fast-path: router caches last decision and continues with deterministic split if observer unreachable.

jordan: Failure modes? If observer has split-brain or DB loss, we need deterministic recoveries.

noah: Agreed. Recovery plan: observer writes compact lease entries (lease_id, epoch, checksum) to local durable store; router validates epoch and checksum. If validation fails, router falls back to stable-variant route and increments "stale-decision" metric.

sre-bot: Note from previous incident: central decision planes caused cascading stalls. Recommend local TTL, exponential probe backoff, and circuit thresholds.

maya: Also request a per-customer opt-out toggle for Private deployments (some customers want zero external control).

alex: API sketch for decision call (pseudo):
```json
{"path":"/v1/observer/decision","body":{"route_key":"booking-prompt","session_id":"abc123"},"response":{"variant":"v2","reason":"canary-grant"}}
```

noah: Implementation checklist: 1) runtime telemetry hooks (latency, error-rate, kv-cache hit), 2) observer service + lease protocol, 3) router local-fallback fast-path, 4) rollout UI flags + per-tenant opt-out, 5) integration tests + chaos scenarios. I'll open RFC PR with diagrams.

jordan: Can we add SLIs: observer_latency_p50/p95, stale_decision_rate, observer_unavailable_rate?

noah: Yes — will include. Also propose a small canary: enable observer for 5% internal traffic for two weeks, monitor regressions.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: observer-service.canary -> us-west-2 @ Thu 09:00 UTC :rocket:

maya: Nice. Ping when RFC lands. :thumbsup:
